data.gender_notes: Pranali is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pranali is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'prana', which refers to the life force or breath of living beings. This name is believed to signify a gift or grace of prana, symbolizing the continuation and flourishing of life. In Hindu mythology, Pranali is associated with the goddess Parvati, who is known for her nurturing and life-giving qualities.
